mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% triggers a recessionary signal, leading to reduced corporate earnings growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in >60% of instances where UNRATE crosses above 6.5%, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant negative effect.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in demand-side activity (GDPC1) and supply-side production (INDPRO) indicate robust economic growth, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when both proxies are rising.

mechanism_narrative: A tightening monetary policy cycle characterized by rising FEDFUNDS rates and elevated CPIAUCSL inflation signals higher interest rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2% in 1 month and CPIAUCSL > 2.0%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS rises >0.2% and CPIAUCSL >2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in demand-side economic activity (GDPC1) signals robust corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when GDPC1 is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in CPIAUCSL inflation above 2.5% triggers higher risk premium expectations, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both demand indicators HOUST and RSAFS signals robust economic activity, driving corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising.

mechanism_narrative: A late-cycle expansion characterized by low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong payrolls (PAYEMS > 1.5 million) signals peak growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE <4.0% and PAYEMS >1.5 million.
